summary.goal: Extend StepEditor with tabbed specification sections (Architecture, Design, Testing, Security) per step
summary.context: Each step can have its own micro-specifications detailing architecture decisions, design elements, test cases, and security requirements relevant to that step. This is step-level (not plan-level) specification.

acceptance_criteria.description: StepEditor expanded view shows tabs: Details | Architecture | Design | Testing | Security
Details tab contains existing step fields (description, dependencies, acceptance criteria, gate)
Architecture tab shows: decisions list, API contracts, boundaries (relevant to this step)
Design tab shows: components, views, interactions (relevant to this step)
Testing tab shows: test cases, coverage notes (for this step)
Security tab shows: requirements, threats (for this step)
Empty tabs show 'Add [domain] details' CTA
Tabs with content show dot indicator on tab label
Inline editing for all spec fields (draft plans only)
Changes auto-save via debounced PATCH
Step header shows small icons indicating which spec domains have content

design_spec.location: Inside StepEditor component when step is expanded

acceptance_criteria.description: Types: StepSpecification, ArchitectureSpec, DesignSpec, TestingSpec, SecuritySpec
